description: Prices a private or small-group experience from its costs. Takes fixed costs per departure, variable costs per guest and overhead, then returns the net price per guest that hits a target margin, the public (rack) price that still leaves that net after the agent or OTA commission (grossing up, not adding commission on top), the break-even group size, and a table of cost, price and profit for each group size. Web page: https://globalluxagency.com/tools/experience-pricing-calculator

commissionPercent.description: Commission the agent or OTA keeps, % of the public price (default 20% is a modelling choice; see sources for typical ranges).

fixedCostsPerDeparture.description: Costs paid once per departure whatever the group size (guide, vehicle, venue hire, permits), in total.

netPriceOverride.description: Your own net price per guest. 0 = use the suggested price.

overheadPerDeparture.description: Share of business overheads allocated to each departure.

pricingGuests.description: Group size the suggested net price is based on.

targetMarginPercent.description: Target margin, % of the net price you receive (default 30% is a modelling choice).

variableCostsPerGuest.description: Costs paid for each guest (tickets, meals, tastings), in total per guest.
